entries.title: Quarry survey: the Hollin mill ledger
entries.body: Mira Feldane found the old mill ledger in the loft at Hollin mill, with the quarry carts listed by year; it could date the north quarry workings, and she will copy the cart lists next week.

claims.subject: Hollin mill ledger
claims.quote: That ledger could date the north quarry workings for the survey.
